empty.eyebrow: A new backing track every {{days}} days
empty.title: No backing track this round yet
empty.body: A round starts the moment there is a track to play over. Add a YouTube link to one and it goes live straight away — everybody can then jam to it, film a take and link it here.

how.title: How improv rounds work
how.intro: One backing track, {{days}} days, everybody plays over it. No scores and no winners — it's a jam, and the conversation about it happens on Discord.

listen.title: Play along
listen.body: Hit play here or open the track on YouTube. Warm up over it for as long as you like.

record.title: Film a take
record.body: Record yourself improvising with your phone. One go, no editing — mistakes are welcome.

link.title: Link it here
link.body: Put the video on YouTube, Instagram or Google Drive and paste the link. That's your take.

discord.title: Get feedback on Discord
discord.body: Our bot posts your take to the round's thread. That's where people react and talk it through.

how.discord_body: Every round gets its own thread on our server. The bot announces the track there, posts each take the moment you link it, and the feedback lives in that thread — this page is where you play and submit, Discord is where you talk.

rules.0: Have fun. No scores, no winners.
rules.1: Improvise. A rough idea is fine, a written-out solo isn't.
rules.2: Warm up as long as you like. Once you hit record, that's your take.
rules.title: House rules

submit.placeholder: Paste a YouTube, Instagram or Google Drive link…
submit.hint: Every take is posted to the round's Discord thread automatically.
submit.limit: You've used all {{max}} takes this round.
submit.error_BAD_LINK: That doesn't look like a YouTube, Instagram or Google Drive video link.
submit.error_LIMIT: You've already posted {{max}} takes on this round.
submit.error_NO_ROUND: There is no round running right now.
submit.error: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

take.none_body: Somebody has to go first. Play over the track, film it and paste the link above.
take.no_round: Takes open as soon as a backing track is live.

side.discord_body: This round's own thread. Every take lands there, and so does the feedback.
side.discord_body_no_thread: Feedback happens on our Discord server. Join in and say hi.

next.title: The next round starts on {{date}}
next.body: Every {{days}} days the track with the most votes becomes the new round. Add a backing track from YouTube or back somebody else's — on a tie, the one added first wins.
next.empty_body: No tracks are waiting. Add one and it leads the vote for the next round.

upload.title: Add a backing track
upload.description: Paste a link to a backing track on YouTube. It joins the pool, people vote, and the most-backed track becomes the next round.
upload.link_hint: Any backing track on YouTube works — the name is taken from the video. Two to five minutes is best.
upload.rights: Link to a backing track, not to somebody's full song.
upload.error: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.
upload.error_LIMIT: You already have {{max}} tracks waiting in the pool.
upload.error_DUPLICATE: That track is already in the pool.
upload.error_link: That link doesn't work. It has to be a public YouTube video.

past.empty_body: Closed rounds are kept here, with their backing tracks and every take.
past.no_takes: Nobody posted a take on this round.
